title: Treatise on the Whirling Rod Wall
summary: Teaches a Champion to spin both rods into a moving screen and break out of it in one cut.

title: Canon of the Hinge and Orbit
summary: Shows a Xiantian cultivator how to send rods round wide orbits inside a living qi field.

title: Handbook of the Cord-Snare Arts
summary: Teaches Champions and Rulers to set cord snares around limbs, weapons and the ground itself.

title: Great Workbook of the Twin-Stick Method
summary: Sets out the whole twin-stick art for the Xiantian student, from guard to finishing sweep.

title: Dual-Track Handbook of the Paired Rods
summary: Trains each rod along its own track, one guarding while the other strikes, then trading roles.

title: Treatise on the Hawk's Double Stoop
summary: Teaches a Xiantian student to dive with both rods like a hawk, striking twice in one descent.

title: Twin-Court Canon of the Hinge
summary: Teaches the Ruler to hold two courts of defence and attack, one in each rod, around the hinge.

title: Wind-Sworn Handbook of the Gale Orbit
summary: Shows a wind-sworn Xiantian student how to let the rods ride the gale in wide, bearing-true orbits.

title: Plateau Drill-Book of the Bearing Rod
summary: Drills a Ruler to hold one fixed bearing with the rod despite crosswind, uneven ground and sudden attack.

title: Oath-Bearing Canon of the Windward Cord
summary: Teaches the oath-sworn Xiantian student to cast the cord into the wind and take it back at will.
